D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced the youth and adult scholarship
deadline.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, summarized the Neighborhood Safety Meeting that presented to
teenagers regarding NOS.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided facility improvement projects updates, and showed
some updates on the Public Works website.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, made announcements about HUD's new reporting
requirements

Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, provided updates on the fee study and the YEP Program.
